coordinator.quote: “We check fridges and freezers by hand three times per shift. Receiving an alert on the phone when a door stays open at night would protect the reagents we lose today.”

quality.quote: “Every week we download dataloggers and consolidate Excel files for audits. An immutable record with exportable reports would save us hours and avoid regulatory findings.”

faq.title: Questions healthcare visitors may ask first.

q1.question: What is SafeLab?
q1.answer: SafeLab is a B2B SaaS platform for automated environmental monitoring, preventive alerts and traceability in laboratories, hospitals and pharmacy networks.

q2.question: Who is the solution designed for?
q2.answer: It is designed for laboratory coordinators, pharmacy technicians, quality managers and healthcare institutions responsible for sensitive biological inventory.

q3.question: How does SafeLab notify my team about a deviation?
q3.answer: When a reading leaves the allowed range, SafeLab generates an alert in the mobile application with the equipment, the recorded value and the time, so the responsible staff can confirm and attend it.

q4.question: Can I configure the limits for each equipment?
q4.answer: Yes. Each monitored equipment can have its own temperature and humidity limits, and alerts are generated when those limits are exceeded.

q5.question: Does the platform help with audits and compliance?
q5.answer: Yes. SafeLab is intended to support audit processes through automated reporting and persistent historical records that improve traceability.
